newsitem.title: UK: Blue Circle recovers, early fall overdone.
newsitem.headline: Blue Circle recovers, early fall overdone.

text.p: Shares in Blue Circle Industries Plc, the UK building materials group which reported an in-line profit rise of nine percent earlier, recovered part of their early fall by 1125 GMT and some analysts said the decline was overdone.
The shares were down 13-1/2 pence at 402, off the earlier low of 393 pence per share.
Mark Hake, analyst at UBS, said: "I don't know of any particular reason why the shares were down before the analysts' meeting."

"The results were in line, the meeting itself was upbeat. Blue Circle backed up the logic for the St Marys Cement acquisition," said Hake, adding that the outlook for the various divisions was positive.
Blue Circle's annual profits rose nine percent to 297.6 million, with the dividend at 13.25 pence versus 12.5 pence. The results were assisted by a doubling of profits at the heating division.
